integrity: The unrestricted result is supported by an explicit necessary-and-sufficient local-word bijection and exact binomial enumeration, corroborated by independent graph-subset checks. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Only two-row strong-product rectangular king graphs and exactly-two-fair domination; no higher-row, general strong-product, or other fairness parameters are claimed. An independent audit and an exhaustive historical-priority survey have not occurred.
title: All two-fair dominating sets of two-row king graphs: an even polynomial and a three-residue optimum census
